name: gsap
title: GSAP
responsibility: Advanced animation engine — timelines, scrubbed scroll scenes, Flip layout transitions, drag physics, SVG drawing. The heavy artillery; Motion stays the default.
reachFor: Complex sequenced timelines and scrubbed scroll experiences (ScrollTrigger)
Hero scenes with layered parallax / staged entrances
SVG path drawing and morphing, FLIP layout transitions (Flip)
avoid: Simple entrances/hover effects — InView + motion covers those (principle: simple stays simple)
Physics-based React state transitions — React Spring fits better
Loading decorative loops — handcraft/motion is enough
inRepo: 14 presets already build on it (gsap-scroll-draw, gsap-parallax-strata, gsap-flip-grid, gsap-kinetic-marquee, …)
